@obs body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside; set as in the other tables.
@obs figure: the Arabic of the heads is printed with elongated joins (kashīda) in «محولــة», «الاصــل» and «الهجــرة», not transcribed; a mark is printed between «الفرس» and «مطلقة»; the hyphen of «intercalatio-» is printed as a raised dot; specks are printed before the Latin of the Romans, over «ايام» of the Romans and beside «سنون» of the Persians; not transcribed.
@obs body L8: a dot is printed after the 6 of the months of the Romans; not transcribed.
